```json
{
  "up": "Retrieve IC50 activity records for CHEMBL3716726 and all its salt forms against target CHEMBL375. Include the parent compound and all children from the molecule hierarchy. Return compound identifiers, structures, assay details, activity values, and literature references. Output rows must be distinct across the specified columns.",
  "select": [
    "compound_chembl_id",
    "canonical_smiles",
    "compound_key",
    "pubmed_id_or_doi",
    "assay_description",
    "standard_type",
    "standard_relation",
    "standard_value",
    "standard_units",
    "activity_comment",
    "target_chembl_id",
    "target_name",
    "target_organism"
  ],
  "source": [
    "molecule_dictionary",
    "molecule_hierarchy",
    "compound_structures",
    "compound_records",
    "activities",
    "assays",
    "target_dictionary",
    "docs"
  ],
  "join": [
    "molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno = parent_molregno (parent CHEMBL3716726)",
    "molecule_hierarchy.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno (child/salt compounds)",
    "molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno",
    "compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id",
    "activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid",
    "activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id"
  ],
  "filter": [
    "parent molecule chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726'",
    "target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375'",
    "activities.standard_type = 'IC50'"
  ],
  "sort": [
    "compound_chembl_id ASC",
    "canonical_smiles ASC",
    "compound_key ASC",
    "pubmed_id_or_doi ASC",
    "assay_description ASC",
    "standard_type ASC",
    "standard_relation ASC",
    "standard_value ASC",
    "standard_units ASC",
    "activity_comment ASC",
    "target_chembl_id ASC",
    "target_name ASC",
    "target_organism ASC"
  ],
  "limit": null,
  "distinct": true
}
```
